explanation: High-speed (~52 m/s) body strikes the right face of a thin wall with large dt=0.022. Impulse reverses vx (-46.4 to +43.6) but positional correction leaves the circle overlapping the wall by 0.37 > 0.15 limit at step 24. Tiny-dt rerun resolves the same impact cleanly, indicating substep/positional-correction insufficient at large per-step displacement.
